review_type: fresh zero-authorship source and inventory review; no browser, build, database write, or test execution

verdict_a_findings.finding: All 48 original cases are present; inventory criteria are copied exactly. The 176 distinct mode/lifecycle/branch rows each have independent null outcome, empty evidence references, and unverified status. Warm/reload setup now requires separate extension runs and the entrypoint route is conditional.

The no-device steps require permission already allowed, then say clicking the Chat mic opens mic-grant. The offscreen recorder maps missing device to NO_DEVICE, while Chat opens mic-grant only on PERMISSION_DENIED; the stated route cannot observe the no-device popup branch. A plausible controlled sequence is to trigger permission denial with a microphone present so the real mic-grant window opens, then remove/disable input before clicking Allow; this must be verified on Chrome before declaring a runnable fixture. Chat's guest mic action returns a sign-in error before recording, so T10 has no Chat-to-popup path. Preserve the popup's no-device acceptance criterion and leave all unsupported rows unverified.

The case has separate warm and reload rows but its only step begins by reloading the extension. The warm row needs a distinct no-immediate-reload sign-out/reopen path before the post-extension-reload run.

Seven explicit requires_fixture cases correctly retain internal/fault/database assertions without a pass claim. Their controlled context, fault, or pre-existing disposable-row fixtures are unnamed; they are safe as inventory instructions but not ready to execute or close.

verdict_b_findings.finding: No role or account provisioning/mutation is prescribed. Profile writes use synthetic values and restoration; T28 forbids making account, membership, or row fixtures. UI-only evidence is separated from internal assertions in T05-T06. The profile path uses avatar > Profile, and options and Store action paths reflect source.

T10-T12 and T23 are labeled ready despite non-runnable branch steps. A green test result could be assigned to a route that never exercised the named outcome; the row status must remain unverified until corrected and observed.

The earlier 46-case count and generic-entrypoint warning no longer apply: inventory has 20 popup plus 28 profile cases, and the corrected proposal names local toolbar, mic-grant, options, Store toolbar, and avatar Profile entrypoints separately. Emergency-contact email is type=email in current ProfileView; T24 still appropriately records native behavior instead of assuming backend validation.

safe_to_integrate: The 48-case proposal is safe to integrate as an unverified procedure inventory, provided T10-T12 and T23 are flagged for procedure correction before execution. Integration does not change inventory status or prove a browser result.

branch_next_actions.EXT-F-1002-T10: Provide an actual guest-reachable mic-grant launch route or a named controlled browser fixture; the guest Chat mic is gated. Do not replace the popup criterion with the Chat sign-in message.

A permission-denied Chat trigger followed by device removal is only a source-based proposal until demonstrated. Do not count the Chat NO_DEVICE toast as mic-grant coverage.
branch_next_actions.EXT-F-1004-T23:warm: Sign out from selected Profile and reopen the sidepanel without an immediate extension reload; observe stale-selection resolution. Then perform the separate extension reload and repeat for its reload row.
branch_next_actions.seven_requires_fixture_cases: Retain as unverified inventory guidance until each controlled context/fault/row fixture has a named setup and an observable result. No account or role alteration is authorized by the proposal.
